title: Aperture Desk Job
provenance: verified by Highball on Apple M1 Pro / macOS 14.6 / engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r0 (2026-08-23)
notes: DXVK is the verified renderer: office scene renders clean, ~40 fps, ReShade 6.8.0 works on top (re-verified 2026-08-25). On our macOS 14 test machine the other renderers misbehave with current builds: DXMT 0.80 black screen (it targets macOS 15+), D3DMetal severe texture corruption (GPU identity keys and ReShade ruled out by A/B). On macOS 15+ your results may differ.

dxmt.detail: black screen on macOS 14 (DXMT 0.80 targets macOS 15+)

d3dmetal.detail: fast but heavy texture corruption on macOS 14
